name: Ark 575 (Hubble)
blurb: Ark 575, an early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ark575-hubble
story: A small galaxy whose stars move at extreme speeds, a sign that an unusually massive black hole may hide at its heart. Hubble imaged its compact core to help weigh that black hole.

claims.text: ARK575 is one of the early-type galaxies imaged by Hubble program 13050, small galaxies with extremely high velocity dispersions and suspected monster black holes
